an3.59:1.1: Atha kho Jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami . . . pe . . . Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
an3.59:1.2: Yass' assu bho Gotama yañño vā saddhaṃ vā thālipāko vā deyyadhammaṃ vā tevijjesu brāhmaṇesu dānaṃ dadeyyā ti?
an3.59:1.3: Yathākathaṃ pana brāhmaṇa brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ tevijjaṃ paññāpentī ti.
an3.59:1.4: Idha pana bho Gotama brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto hoti mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahāyugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena ajjhāyako mantadharo tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo ti.
an3.59:1.5: Evaṃ kho bho Gotama brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ tevijjaṃ paññāpentī ti.
an3.59:2.1: Aññathā bho brāhmaṇa brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ tevijjaṃ paññāpenti aññathā ca pana ariyassa vinaye tevijjo hotī ti.
an3.59:2.2: Yathākathaṃ bho Gotama ariyassa vinaye tevijjo hoti.
an3.59:2.3: Sādhu me bhavaṃ Gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā ariyassa vinaye tevijjo hotī ti.
an3.59:2.4: Tena hi brāhmaṇa suṇāhi. Sādhukaṃ manasikarohi bhāsissāmī ti.
an3.59:2.5: Evaṃ bho ti kho Jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo Bhagavato paccassosi.
an3.59:3.1: Idha pana brāhmaṇa bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . .
an3.59:4.1: So evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammanīye ṭhite ānejjappatte pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
an3.59:4.2: So anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati -- seyyathīdaṃ ekam pi jātiṃ dve pi jātiyo . . . pe . . . Iti sākāraṃ sa-uddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
an3.59:4.3: Ayam assa paṭhamā vijjā adhigatā hoti
an3.59:4.4: avijjā vigatā vijjā uppannā tamo vigato āloko uppanno yathā taṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato. 3.
an3.59:5.1: So evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammanīye ṭhite ānejjappatte sattānaṃ cutupapātañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
an3.59:5.2: So dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamanussakena . . . pe . . . yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
an3.59:5.3: Ayam assa dutiyā vijjā adhigatā hoti
an3.59:5.4: avijjā vigatā vijjā uppannā tamo vigato āloko uppanno yathā taṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato. 4.
an3.59:6.1: So evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammanīye ṭhite ānejjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
an3.59:6.2: So idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . pe . . . ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī
an3.59:6.4: Tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccati bhavāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccati avijjāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccati,
an3.59:6.6: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyā ti pajānāti.
an3.59:6.7: Ayam assa tatiyā vijjā adhigatā hoti
an3.59:6.8: avijjā vigatā vijjā uppannā tamo vigato āloko uppanno yathā taṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato ti.
an3.59:10.1: Evam eva kho brāhmaṇa ariyassa vinaye tevijjo hotī ti.
an3.59:10.2: Aññathā bho Gotama brāhmaṇānaṃ tevijjo aññathā ca pana ariyassa vinaye tevijjo hoti.
an3.59:10.3: Imassa ca bho Gotama ariyassa vinaye tevijjassa brāhmaṇānaṃ tevijjo kalaṃ nāgghati soḷasiṃ.
an3.59:11.2: Upāsakaṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan
